name: GitHub Copilot CLI
$comment: The dedicated upstream research pass for Copilot did not complete (the run hit a provider budget limit), so unlike the other files here this one is not backed by a fresh binary read. Everything below comes from the earlier live `copilot -p` verification. Fields nobody re-checked are marked unknown rather than carried over on trust.

ask.note: Honoured interactively. A non-interactive run (copilot -p) has nobody to ask and Copilot turns an ask into a deny — its choice, not LeastGrant's, and the safe direction.

onCrash.note: If the hook errors, Copilot denies the call rather than running it. Discovered the hard way — a broken hook command blocked everything. This note used to open "the only agent here that fails closed", which was true when it was written and stopped being true once Cursor and Antigravity were measured; three of the five shipped adapters now fail closed on crash.

canFailClosed.note: It is the default and is not optional.

exposesMode.note: No permission_mode field at all. This is why the attended check is an allowlist: treating an absent mode as `default` banked every completed Copilot call as a human approval.

upstreamLimitations: No permission mode is sent, so LeastGrant cannot tell an attended run from an unattended one and records observation rather than approval. Copilot therefore learns more slowly, deliberately.
Failing closed means a broken or missing LeastGrant blocks all work rather than silently permitting it. Safer, and much louder.
leastgrantLimitations: Speaks Claude Code's wire format, so it shares that adapter. A divergence upstream would surface as Copilot-shaped bugs in a file named for Claude.
This file's unknown fields need a dedicated binary read; the research pass for it did not complete.

live.what: Real `copilot -p` runs with the hook installed at ~/.copilot/hooks/leastgrant.json; all three verdicts honoured, and a hook error observed failing closed.

transport.what: Copilot runs hook commands through PowerShell on Windows; the same quoting failure as Codex was observed, there blocking every call rather than none.

contract.what: Claude-format hooks in snake_case with hookSpecificOutput out; confirmed against the installed CLI.

mechanism: A Claude-format hook file at ~/.copilot/hooks/leastgrant.json. Copilot speaks Claude Code's wire format, so the same handler drives both.

controlPaths.what: the Claude-format hook file LeastGrant installs, and the whole ~/.copilot/hooks directory it sits in
standing instructions every session is given
